verdict.rationale: Box's developer docs index says it offers SDKs, and an official box-org GitHub repository for a TypeScript SDK exists. That repo's notice says it no longer receives new features, updates, bug fixes, or security patches, so the only concretely evidenced SDK is in maintenance-end status. missing for 10: list of supported SDK languages, documentation of a currently maintained SDK, install/usage guides, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Box for Developers: guides, API reference, SDKs, and tutorials for building content management, Box AI
Your existing code will continue to work without changes, but you won't receive new features, updates, bug fixes, or security patches.
